headlines: Stocktwits posters say stocks jumped to session highs as Fed minutes hit (unconfirmed)
AI data-center and miner names (APLD, IREN) fall 5-6%; memory ETF DRAM up

rumors.text: Fed minutes show inflation declining in the medium term, sparking a rally to session highs
rumors.why: A dovish read of the minutes would support further index gains

rumors.text: Bears were crowded and spammed the tape, so SPY is set to squeeze higher into the close
rumors.why: A crowded short bet can fuel a squeeze if price keeps rising

plays.reason: Posters report a bounce on the Fed minutes and VIX is calm near 15.4, but the crowd is already very bullish and small caps lag
plays.catalyst: Fed minutes reaction into the close

readings.whats_new: SPY edged up to about 777.2 (-0.24%) from 776.2 last hour and VIX eased to 15.4. Fed minutes appear to be out, with Stocktwits posters claiming a rally to session highs, though this is unconfirmed. Small caps (IWM -1.2%) and gold (-1.5%) lag while AI data-center names stay weak.
